newsitem.title: USA: NYNEX refiles proposed Mass. rate cut.
newsitem.headline: NYNEX refiles proposed Mass. rate cut.

text.p: NYNEX said it refiled on Thursday its proposed $30 million rate reduction for residence and business customers in Massachusetts.

The telephone company said in a statement it filed the proposal with the Massachusetts Department of Public Utilities (DPU). The proposal calls for the reduction to become effective October 15 and includes a volume discount plan for businesses and a residence unlimited calling plan for eastern Massachusetts.
If approved, the changes would bring to $68 million the total of NYNEX rate reductions made since price regulation was introduced by the DPU in 1995.
The filing mirrors one NYNEX was asked to withdraw while the DPU issued a related order in another proceeding about cost studies and establishing minimum prices for services.
The DPU on August 29 issued its order which requires NYNEX to calculate and be in compliance with price floors for all of its services by its third annual price cap filing on June 1, 1997.
